parole.significato: A Middle Eastern dessert composed of a cheese pastry soaked in syrup.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Arabic كُنافة (kunāfa), itself possibly from Coptic ⲕⲉⲛⲉⲫⲓⲧⲉⲛ (kenephiten).

parole.significato: A kind of wide loose drawers or trousers worn by women in Muslim countries.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Arabic شِنْتِيَان (šintiyān) which is itself from Coptic ϣⲉⲛⲧⲱ (šentō).
